sections.en: 1 With a few changes, this fragment was excerpted from the anonymous commentary on Ptolemy's Tetrabiblos published in Basel in 1559, p. 21, v. 5-40 (on Ptol. I, 4), as F. Boll kindly advised us.

summary.headline: Astrological Catalog Entries 384–400
summary.text: Catalog entries 384–400 from Florentine manuscript folios 244v–271, covering planetary colors and materials, lunar-star configurations, house divisions, planetary outcomes, zodiacal changes and signs, applications, eclipses, horoscoping, culmination, stellar conjunctions, lunar observations, intervention, signification of the twelve signs, stars under the beams, and solar-eclipse outcomes. The apparatus identifies an excerpt from an anonymous commentary on Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos and cites F. Boll.
